# Suno Music Prompt Laboratory

> Searchable archive of 126+ iterative prompt engineering experiments for [Suno AI](https://suno.com) music generation (v5.5). Each experiment is a handcrafted YAML prompt exploring cinematic, orchestral, and experimental music with full style descriptions, structural metatags, embedded players, and engineering notes.

**Author:** Alexandru DAN · [alexandrudan.com](https://alexandrudan.com)
**Live site:** [suno.alexandrudan.com](https://suno.alexandrudan.com)
**Repository:** [github.com/danlex/suno-lab](https://github.com/danlex/suno-lab)

## What this site contains

- **126+ versioned prompts** — YAML files showing iterative refinements for Suno v5.5
- **16 architectural forms explored** — bolero, passacaglia, lone-center, fugue, arch (ABCBA), rondo (ABACA), theme-and-variations, canon/round, dissolution (inverted arc), concerto grosso, sonata, ricercare, passamezzo, micropolyphony, orchestral glitch, plus the default build-silence-return
- **Engineering notes per prompt** — what was tested, what worked, what didn't
- **Embedded Suno players** — listen to generated results directly on the page
- **Structured metadata** — key, BPM, featured instruments, exclude styles, tags
- **Full-text search** — filter by title, tag, key, BPM, style, or instrument

## Key techniques documented

- **Silence before climax** as frisson trigger (build to 80%, drop to near-silence, deliver climax)
- **Half-step modulation** at climax (e.g., D major → Eb major, occasionally downward)
- **Three-layer instrument control** — genre anchor + specify instruments + negative prompts + exclude_styles field
- **Conversational style prompts** (flowing prose, not comma-separated tags) for Suno v5.5
- **Explicit timestamps** within the style field to guide arc structure
- **Purpose phrase** ("film score for X scene") to anchor emotional context
- **Deep instrument revivals** tracked via automated novelty surface analysis

## Prompt format

Each prompt in `prompts/*.yaml` contains: `name`, `version`, `style` (≤1000 chars, target 850-950), `title`, `lyrics` (with structural metatags), `instrumental`, `exclude_styles`, `notes`, `tags`.

## Experimental process

1. Research one topic per cycle (new instruments, genre fusions, Baroque/Classical forms, film scoring trends)
2. Draft a versioned YAML prompt with one meaningful change from prior versions
3. Score against 9-criterion judge rubric (must reach ≥90/100)
4. Submit via browser automation to suno.com/create in Custom Mode
5. Commit and push with detailed notes

## Important constraints learned empirically

- **Suno duration is NOT prompt-controllable.** Duration language ("total duration 1:00 to 2:00") does not reliably produce target-length output. Cropping is the only reliable way to get exact durations.
- **Style placeholder text rotates randomly.** The Suno UI shows different example styles on each page load.
- **Certain words trigger unintended genres.** "Dune"/"desert" triggers Arabic scales. "Epic"/"massive" triggers rock. Composer names should be avoided.
